purpose: Observation-material review and controlled recovery checks across column material/prompt upgrades; no real model request or user database was used.

material_review.ownership_claim: Heading metadata describes actual original DOM locations and common containing regions. It does not infer department ownership or assign every nearby list to a tab.

upgrade_failure_before_fix.pending_result: execution_conflict prevented retrieval of the original completed execution
upgrade_failure_before_fix.settled_result: A metadata-only change reset the completed cursor and lost retained candidate columns and decision IDs in recognition state.

behaviors_verified: Read the original durable execution ID before compiling changed materials or binding a new model.

Adopt a complete success only when original evidence input digest, skill digest, binding, school and URL match and its full column output validates. Normal program scope/title/body verification still follows.
Unknown outcomes and usage remain waiting without issuing a new ID; a success with unknown usage is consumed only once.
Active reserved/sending requests return to the pending queue after 10 seconds and can settle between claims; existing worker recovery handles stale executions.
Preserve cursor, candidate columns and original paid IDs for an exact heading-metadata-only upgrade.
Changed partitions reuse only exact completed evidence boundaries; one completed fragment cannot declare an enlarged region complete.
Missing original evidence or conflicting input retains the execution and progress without adopting its output or purchasing a replacement.
Column-mode partial output is not adopted as a complete set of rules.
Known-unsent failures require strict zero usage, request_sent exactly false, no reservation and no output. Provider pauses reuse the shared unsent_pause predicate.
Cached preflight pauses enter the connection handoff with cursor and decision counts unchanged.
Store the actual execution ID from runtime provenance, including resumed execution IDs.
recovery_after_fix.budget_guards: The controlled school ledger remained at 40 used requests and retained its original used/reserved tokens, request reservations and active counts; limits were not raised.

focused_regression.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -X utf8 -m pytest tests/test_column_material_upgrade.py tests/test_column_unknown_checkpoint.py tests/test_source_agent.py tests/test_column_regions.py tests/test_ai_connection_tasks.py -q --disable-warnings

confirmed_original_failure_reproductions: Inconsistent zero-fee evidence preserves pending work with execution_conflict and zero dispatches.
Already consumed success with unknown usage pauses with ai_result_unknown and leaves one copy of its columns.
Cached provider pause enters ai_connection while cursor remains zero.
independent_review.counting_note: This independent test set overlaps the 58-test set and is not added as distinct coverage.

limitations: These controlled recovery checks do not prove real API performance or full RUC school discovery coverage.
Legacy success rows without recoverable original input remain explicitly paused; a missing input is not reconstructed by guessing or replacing the original paid request.
Original-site replay checks validate retained observations, not current fresh website behavior.
